notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {1}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
